summary: Two-shot: the guest stands, sees the glow at the kitchen door and points at it; the host glances back at the door and answers with a grin.
framing: Medium two-shot from behind the guest's right shoulder, eye level, static; same setup as the end of S38 (after its tilt). Guest left foreground, host right, kitchen door between and behind them.
